Error400.description: The request is invalid; the body says why.

Error403.description: Refused: with no UI auth mode, a client that is not local (only kubectl port-forward is served) or a cross-origin request from an origin not in --cors-allowed-origins; in TokenReview mode, Kubernetes RBAC denied an object the request reads or writes; for the Bundle API, a namespace this controller does not watch.

Error409.description: Conflict: an ambiguous name, an object that already exists, or nothing to promote or roll back to.

Error503.description: TokenReview mode: the TokenReview or SubjectAccessReview API cannot be reached, so the request is refused (fail closed).

Actor.description: Actor records who made a change: the kardinal.io/actor stamp. Kind, principal, agent, sponsor and via are verified: the chart's <release>-actor ValidatingAdmissionPolicy admits a stamp only when it says what request.userInfo resolves to through the AgentIndex, and only the controller may set via. Everything under asserted is written by the client and never trusted.

agent.description: Agent is the AgentIdentity name, when kind is agent.

asserted.description: Asserted holds what the client says about itself. It is recorded as written and never used for a security decision.

kind.description: Kind is human, agent, bot or controller (docs/actors.md).

principal.description: Principal is the username the API server authenticated.

sponsor.description: Sponsor is the agent's sponsor (AgentIdentity spec.sponsor.user) when the record was written, when kind is agent.

via.description: Via says how the controller came to write the record: ui and api for a caller it authenticated, subscription and auto-rollback for its own Bundles. Only the controller may set it.

AssertedActor.description: AssertedActor is what a client says about itself: not verified.

client.description: Client is the tool that wrote the record (for example kardinal/0.12.0).

model.description: Model is the AI model the client says it runs.

session.description: Session is the client's session or run identifier.

Bundle.description: uiBundleResponse is the JSON shape for a Bundle in the UI API.

actor.description: Actor is who created the Bundle (docs/actors.md): its stamp, or kind unknown with its kardinal.io/created-by.

actorText.description: ActorText is Actor as one sentence ("agent fixer for alice"), and ActorAsserted what it asserted about itself, labelled as asserted.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 creation time for timeline sorting

environments.description: Per-environment statuses. The bundle comparison shows them and the release metrics bar reads HealthCheckedAt; the timeline does not.

images.description: Container images in this Bundle — used by NodeDetail diff preview.

rejected.description: Rejected is spec.rejected: who rejected the Bundle (kardinal reject), why and when. Absent when it is not rejected.

rejectedLiveEnvironments.description: RejectedLiveEnvironments are the environments where this Rejected Bundle's change is live (lifecycle.RejectedLiveEnvs): the UI keeps it current there, marked Rejected, with a roll-back hint.

version.description: Version is what the Bundle ships, for display: status.version, else scm.BundleVersion of its spec (a Bundle the reconciler has not seen yet).

BundleEnvironment.description: uiBundleEnvStatus is the per-environment status summary of a Bundle. The UI reads Name, Phase and HealthCheckedAt; nothing in it reads PRURL.

healthCheckedAt.description: HealthCheckedAt is when the post-merge health check for this environment completed (RFC 3339). The release metrics bar uses it for time-to-production.

BundleIntent.description: BundleIntent declares optional promotion targeting and skip overrides.

skipEnvironments.description: SkipEnvironments lists environment names to exclude from this promotion, subject to the PolicyGate SkipPermission check.

targetEnvironment.description: TargetEnvironment restricts this Bundle to promoting only up to and including this environment. Empty means promote through all environments.

author.description: Author is the committer or triggering actor for this build.

ciRunURL.description: CIRunURL is the URL of the CI run that built this Bundle.

commitSHA.description: CommitSHA is the application source commit that produced this Bundle: 4 to 64 hex characters, or an image digest (a Subscription records the digest it found).

rollbackOf.description: RollbackOf is the name of the Bundle this Bundle rolls back (if any).

timestamp.description: Timestamp is when the bundle was built.

ChartRef.description: ChartRef identifies a Helm chart version.

digest.description: Digest is the chart package digest (index.yaml digest, or the OCI manifest digest).

name.description: Name is the chart name: letters, digits, ".", "_" and "-", starting and ending with a letter or digit. It is joined into the chart's index and OCI paths, so a "/", "]" or other path character would point the version lookup elsewhere.

repoURL.description: RepoURL is the chart repository (https://... or oci://...).

Condition.description: uiCondition is the JSON shape for a Kubernetes condition.

ConfigRef.description: ConfigRef identifies a GitOps repository commit.

commitSHA.description: CommitSHA is the exact commit SHA for this config snapshot: 4 to 64 hex characters.

gitRepo.description: GitRepo is the GitOps repository URL.

CreateBundleRequest.description: bundleCreateRequest is the JSON body accepted by POST /api/v1/bundles.

chart.description: Chart is the Helm chart version of a "chart" bundle.

configRef.description: ConfigRef is the GitOps commit for "config" and "mixed" bundles.

images.description: Images lists the container images in this Bundle.

intent.description: Intent limits or shapes the promotion (targetEnvironment, skipEnvironments).

namespace.description: Namespace is the target namespace. Defaults to the server's default namespace.

pipeline.description: Pipeline is the target Pipeline name.

type.description: Type is the bundle type: "image", "config", "mixed" or "chart". When omitted it is inferred (lifecycle.InferBundleType): chart from chart, mixed from images and configRef, config from configRef, else image.

CreateBundleResponse.description: bundleCreateResponse is the JSON response for POST /api/v1/bundles.

name.description: Name is the name of the created Bundle CRD.

namespace.description: Namespace is the namespace of the created Bundle CRD.

EnvironmentNode.description: uiEnvironmentNode is the static topology shape for one environment in a Pipeline. Used by the frontend to render the DAG when no active Bundle is promoting.

approval.description: Approval is "auto" or "pr-review" — shown as a badge on the node.

dependsOn.description: DependsOn is the list of environment names this one depends on. Empty means this environment starts at the root of the DAG.

fleet.description: Fleet is set on a fleet environment: its targets' environments, which environmentStates and deployed are keyed by, and its pacing.

hold.description: Hold is the environment's hold (spec.holds, kardinal rollback --hold), nil when it is not held.

upstreams.description: Upstreams are the environments this one waits for as the controller resolves them (dependsOn, waves, or the previous entry), sorted; empty for a root. Absent when the Pipeline's ordering is invalid.

Event.description: uiEventResponse is the JSON shape for a Kubernetes event in the UI API.

GateOverrideRequest.description: uiGateOverrideRequest is the body of POST /api/v1/ui/gates/{name}/approve.

expiresInMinutes.description: ExpiresInMinutes is how long the override lasts, 1 to 1440. Defaults to 60.

namespace.description: Namespace of the gate, used only with the {name}/approve form; the {namespace}/{name}/approve form takes it from the path.

reason.description: Reason is recorded on the override and in the audit trail. Required.

stage.description: Stage limits the override to one environment. Empty overrides the gate in every environment it applies to.

Graph.description: uiGraphResponse is the DAG response for a Bundle.

GraphEdge.description: uiGraphEdge is a directed dependency edge in the promotion DAG.

GraphNode.description: uiGraphNode is a node in the promotion DAG.

holding.description: Holding is set on a PolicyGate node whose gate holds the bundle back (graph.GateHolds, the rule blockerCount uses); its State is "Block". See graph.GateState for the other gate states.

startedAt.description: ISO 8601 step creation time for elapsed timers

ImageRef.description: ImageRef identifies a container image by repository, tag, and/or digest.

digest.description: Digest is the image digest (sha256:...), in the OCI digest grammar.

tag.description: Tag is the image tag, in the OCI distribution grammar: up to 128 characters of [A-Za-z0-9_.-], not starting with "." or "-".

MessageResponse.description: uiMessageResponse is the response of an action that creates nothing.

Pipeline.description: uiPipelineResponse is the JSON shape for a Pipeline in the UI API.

activeBundleActor.description: ActiveBundleActor is who shipped the active Bundle (the Agents filter); absent when that is not known.

activeBundleVersion.description: ActiveBundleVersion is what the active Bundle ships (scm.BundleVersion: the image tag, or "config <sha>"), for the fleet board.

blockerCount.description: Operations table columns: derived from active Bundle + steps + gates. BlockerCount is the number of the active bundle's PolicyGates with ready=false in environments it has reached (every upstream Verified) but not started; see blockingGateCount.

conditions.description: Conditions are the Pipeline's status.conditions: Ready (with reasons such as ValidationFailed, GitCredentialMissing and SecretNotReferenceable), Paused and PathConflict.

deployed.description: Deployed is, per environment, the Bundle whose change the environment runs: the newest PromotionStep there that landed its change (lifecycle.DeployedIn, as kardinal status reports). Environments that never received one are absent.

deploymentMetrics.description: DeploymentMetrics is the Pipeline's status.deploymentMetrics, written by the PipelineReconciler (DORA throughput and stability for the last environment). Nil until a Bundle is Verified there.

environmentStates.description: per-environment state counts for the multi-segment health bar. Derived from the active Bundle's status.environments. Keys are environment names, values are the promotion phase.

environmentTopology.description: static pipeline topology from spec — rendered even when no Bundle is promoting. Each entry is one environment in pipeline order with its dependsOn edges.

environments.description: Environments is the Pipeline's status.environments, written by the PipelineReconciler: per environment what runs there, a newer Bundle on its way in, its state and since when, and what holds it (P1). Display only; the same rows kubectl and the CLI read.

failedStepCount.description: FailedStepCount is the number of PromotionSteps with state=Failed for the active bundle.

failedVersion.description: FailedVersion is the Pipeline's status.failedVersion: why its newest version failed (the Bundle's reason and message), absent otherwise.

inventoryAgeDays.description: InventoryAgeDays is the number of days since the latest bundle was created. A high value indicates stale inventory (no recent deploys). A pointer so that 0 ("created today") is sent; nil means no active bundle.

lastMergedAt.description: LastMergedAt is the RFC3339 timestamp of the last env that reached Verified. Empty string when no environment has been verified yet.

summary.description: Summary is the Pipeline's status.summary, one sentence on where its versions are.

topologyResolved.description: TopologyResolved is true when the controller resolved the ordering, so environmentTopology[].upstreams is complete: an entry without upstreams is a root (a Pipeline whose every environment is in wave 1 has only roots). Absent when the ordering is invalid.

PipelineActionRequest.description: uiPipelineActionRequest is the body of POST /api/v1/ui/pause and POST /api/v1/ui/resume.

environment.description: Environment, when set, pauses or resumes only this fleet environment (spec.pausedFleets) instead of the whole Pipeline.

namespace.description: Namespace of the Pipeline. Defaults to "default".

pipeline.description: Pipeline is the Pipeline to pause or resume.

PipelineDeploymentMetrics.description: PipelineDeploymentMetrics holds aggregate promotion efficiency metrics for a Pipeline. Computed by PipelineReconciler from the last 30 Verified Bundles for this pipeline. Displayed by `kardinal metrics` and the UI pipeline detail view.

autoRollbackRateMillis.description: AutoRollbackRateMillis is the fraction of sampled Bundles that are rollbacks (spec.provenance.rollbackOf is set), manual (`kardinal rollback`, the UI) or automatic, expressed as integer thousandths (e.g. 83 = 8.3%). Stored as integer to avoid floating-point in CRD YAML.

changeFailureRateMillis.description: ChangeFailureRateMillis is failedDeployments / deployments as integer thousandths (DORA change failure rate; 250 = 25%).

computedAt.description: ComputedAt is when these metrics were last written by the PipelineReconciler.

deployments.description: Deployments is the number of deployments the change failure rate and time to restore are computed over: the last 30 Bundles whose change reached a final environment (one nothing depends on; its health check started), whatever the outcome, once per Bundle. Not deployments: a no-op promotion (outputs.noChanges), the steps a supersession cancelled (a RollingBack, AbortedByAlarm or already Failed step of a superseded Bundle still counts), and rollback Bundles (they count only as restores).

failedDeployments.description: FailedDeployments is how many of those deployments failed: a PromotionStep in a final environment ended Failed, AbortedByAlarm or RollingBack after its health check started, a rollback Bundle later rolled a final environment back from it (annotation kardinal.io/rollback-from), or the Bundle was rejected after it was deployed.

meanTimeToRestoreMinutes.description: MeanTimeToRestoreMinutes is the mean, in whole minutes, from each failed deployment reaching a final environment to the first later Bundle Verified in every final environment it targets, in every region (DORA time to restore). Failures not restored yet are not counted.

operatorInterventionRateMillis.description: OperatorInterventionRateMillis is the fraction of sampled Bundles that had at least one PolicyGate override applied, expressed as integer thousandths.

p50CommitToProdMinutes.description: P50CommitToProdMinutes is the median time (minutes) from Bundle creation to the final environment reaching Verified, over the sample window.

p90CommitToProdMinutes.description: P90CommitToProdMinutes is the 90th-percentile time (minutes) from Bundle creation to the final environment reaching Verified, over the sample window.

restoredFailures.description: RestoredFailures is the number of failed deployments in meanTimeToRestoreMinutes.

rolloutsLast30Days.description: RolloutsLast30Days is the number of successful (Verified) promotions to the final pipeline environment in the last 30 calendar days.

sampleSize.description: SampleSize is the number of Bundles included in this computation.

staleProdDays.description: StaleProdDays is the number of days since the last successful promotion to the final pipeline environment. 0 means a promotion completed today. Until a Bundle is Verified there, deploymentMetrics is not set at all.

PipelineEnvironmentStatus.description: PipelineEnvironmentStatus is what one environment of a Pipeline runs, and where the newest version that reached it stands.

blockedBy.description: BlockedBy names the gates that hold the newest Bundle back in the environment, sorted.

bundle.description: Bundle is the Bundle whose change runs in the environment: the newest one whose change landed there. Empty when none has.

held.description: Held is true when a rollback hold (spec.holds) keeps the environment on Bundle, so the newest Bundle waits.

incomingBundle.description: IncomingBundle is a newer Bundle on its way into the environment (its step there is not yet live, or gates hold it before its step exists). Empty when the newest Bundle there is Bundle.

prURL.description: PRURL is the pull request of the newest Bundle's step while it waits for its merge.

since.description: Since is when State began: the Verified time for Verified, otherwise when the controller first recorded this Bundle in this State.

state.description: State is the PromotionStep state of the newest Bundle in the environment (IncomingBundle when set, else Bundle), an API value such as Verified or WaitingForMerge. Pending with BlockedBy set when gates hold the Bundle before its step exists. Empty when no Bundle reached the environment.

version.description: Version is what Bundle ships: the image tag, "config <sha>" or the chart version.

PipelineFailedVersion.description: PipelineFailedVersion is why the newest version of a Pipeline failed.

environment.description: Environment is the environment whose step failed; empty when the Bundle failed before any step.

message.description: Message is that condition's message: what failed and, where known, what fixes it.

reason.description: Reason is the reason of the Bundle's InvalidSpec condition (GraphBuildFailed, InvalidIntent, InvalidPipeline, ...) or of its Failed condition.

since.description: Since is when the Bundle failed (its Ready condition's transition).

version.description: Version is what Bundle ships (the image tag, "config <sha>" or the chart version).

PipelineOverrideRequest.description: uiPipelineOverrideRequest is the body of POST /api/v1/ui/override: the override of a gate template in one environment of a Pipeline, recorded on the instances its in-progress Bundles have (kardinal override).

environment.description: Environment is the environment the override applies to. Required.

expiresInMinutes.description: ExpiresInMinutes is how long the override lasts, 1 to the cap (--gate-override-max-minutes). Defaults to 60.

gate.description: Gate is the gate template name (or the name of one gate instance).

namespace.description: Namespace of the Pipeline. Defaults to "default".

pipeline.description: Pipeline whose in-progress Bundles' gate instances get the override.

reason.description: Reason is recorded on the override and in the audit trail. Required.

PipelineOverrideResponse.description: uiPipelineOverrideResponse is the response of POST /api/v1/ui/override.

expiresAt.description: ExpiresAt is when the override expires (RFC 3339).

gates.description: Gates are the gate instances that got the override.

PolicyGate.description: uiGateResponse is the JSON shape for a PolicyGate.

approval.description: Approval is the gate's approval quorum and who approved (an approval gate, spec.approval). Absent for a gate without one.

createdAt.description: CreatedAt is when the gate instance was created (RFC 3339): when its environment started waiting on it. The approvals inbox orders by it.

gateTemplate.description: GateTemplate is the template an instance was made from (its kardinal.io/gate-template label): the gate's name as the user wrote it, which the UI shows and POST /override takes. Empty on templates.

holding.description: Holding is true when this gate instance holds its bundle back (graph.GateHolds, the rule blockerCount uses). A not-ready gate that is not holding is waiting for the bundle, not blocking it.

maxOverrideMinutes.description: MaxOverrideMinutes is the longest override the controller accepts for an instance (--gate-override-max-minutes). Unset on templates.

pipeline.description: Pipeline, Bundle and Environment come from the kardinal.io/* labels the graph builder sets on gate instances. They are empty on templates.

state.description: State is the state the UI shows: Pass, Block, Superseded, Pending or Waiting (graph.GateState), the same as the gate's node in the bundle graph and the STATE kardinal explain prints.

template.description: Template is true for a PolicyGate template (no kardinal.io/bundle label). Templates are never evaluated for a bundle and always report ready=false, so the UI must not count them as blocking.

verify.description: Verify is the gate's verify policy and its verdicts (a verify gate, spec.verify). Absent for a gate without one.

PolicyGateOverride.description: uiGateOverride is the JSON shape for a PolicyGateOverride (an audit record).

createdByVerified.description: CreatedByVerified is true when the chart's identity admission policy checked createdBy (status.overrides): false for an override recorded while the policy was not bound, or before the upgrade that added it.

PromoteRequest.description: uiPromoteRequest is the body of POST /api/v1/ui/promote.

environment.description: Environment is the environment to promote to; its upstreams must have a Verified Bundle.

namespace.description: Namespace of the Pipeline. Defaults to "default".

pipeline.description: Pipeline is the Pipeline to promote in.

PromoteResponse.description: uiPromoteResponse is the 201 response of POST /api/v1/ui/promote.

bundle.description: Bundle is the promotion Bundle created.

source.description: Source is the Verified Bundle whose artifacts it promotes.

PromotionStep.description: uiStepResponse is the JSON shape for a PromotionStep.

bakeElapsedMinutes.description: Bake countdown fields (served; the UI does not show them yet). BakeElapsedMinutes is contiguous healthy minutes so far in the current bake window.

bakeResets.description: BakeResets is the number of times the bake timer was reset due to a health alarm.

bakeTargetMinutes.description: BakeTargetMinutes is the required contiguous healthy duration from Pipeline spec. Zero means no bake is configured for this environment.

conditions.description: Kubernetes conditions — shown in NodeDetail conditions panel.

steps.description: Steps is the per-step progress from status.steps[], in execution order. The UI renders it as the step progress list.

RejectRequest.description: uiRejectRequest is the body of POST /api/v1/ui/reject.

bundle.description: Bundle is the Bundle to reject.

namespace.description: Namespace of the Bundle. Defaults to "default".

reason.description: Reason is recorded in spec.rejected and the audit trail. Required.

RollbackRequest.description: uiRollbackRequest is the body of POST /api/v1/ui/rollback.

environment.description: Environment is the environment to roll back.

hold.description: Hold keeps the environment on the rollback until it is released (kardinal rollback --hold): no other Bundle promotes into it, and the rollback passes the gates that would block it, each pass audited.

holdExpiresIn.description: HoldExpiresIn, a Go duration such as 24h, ends the hold that long after it is made. Empty: the hold lasts until it is released.

holdReason.description: HoldReason says why the environment is held. Required with hold.

namespace.description: Namespace of the Pipeline. Defaults to "default".

pipeline.description: Pipeline is the Pipeline to roll back.

toBundle.description: ToBundle is the Bundle to go back to. Empty means the most recent Bundle, other than the one deployed now, that was Verified in the environment.

RollbackResponse.description: uiRollbackResponse is the 201 response of POST /api/v1/ui/rollback.

bundle.description: Bundle is the rollback Bundle created.

fleet.description: Fleet is set for the rollback of a whole fleet: each target, in fleet order, with the Bundle it runs and whether the rollback changes it.

held.description: Held is true when the environment is held on the rollback.

rollbackOf.description: RollbackOf is the Bundle whose artifacts it restores.

StepStatus.description: uiStepStatus is the JSON shape for one entry of PromotionStep status.steps[].

UICreateBundleRequest.description: uiCreateBundleRequest is the body of POST /api/v1/ui/bundles.

image.description: Image is the image reference: repo:tag, repo@sha256:digest or repo.

namespace.description: Namespace of the Pipeline. Defaults to "default".

pipeline.description: Pipeline is the Pipeline the Bundle promotes through.

UICreateBundleResponse.description: uiCreateBundleResponse is the 201 response of POST /api/v1/ui/bundles.

bundle.description: Bundle is the name of the created Bundle.

message.description: Message describes how to follow it.

ValidateCELRequest.description: uiValidateCELRequest is the body of POST /api/v1/ui/validate-cel.

expression.description: Expression is the PolicyGate CEL expression to compile.

ValidateCELResponse.description: uiValidateCELResponse is the response of POST /api/v1/ui/validate-cel.

error.description: Error is the compile error when Valid is false.

valid.description: Valid is true when the expression compiles in the PolicyGate CEL environment.

WebhookHealth.description: webhookHealthResponse is the body of GET /webhook/scm/health.

eventsProcessed.description: EventsProcessed counts the signed webhook events of any type since startup.

mergedPREvents.description: MergedPREvents counts the merged pull request events among them.

webhookConfigured.description: WebhookConfigured is true when a webhook secret is set; without one every event is refused.

uiAccessCheck.description: uiAccessCheck is one action the UI asks about: verb on a kardinal.io resource (or virtual subresource) in the request's namespace.

name.description: Name is the object, when the check is for one.

resource.description: Resource is a kardinal.io resource, plural: bundles, pipelines, approvals, policygates.

subresource.description: Subresource is a virtual subresource such as pause, hold, reject or override.

verb.description: Verb and Resource (with Subresource) name one of the UI's actions: create bundles, create approvals, update policygates/override, update pipelines/pause, update pipelines/hold or update bundles/reject.

uiAccessRequest.description: uiAccessRequest is the body of POST /api/v1/ui/access.

checks.description: Checks are answered in order, at most 32.

namespace.description: Namespace the checks are in. Defaults to "default".

uiAccessResponse.description: uiAccessResponse is the body of a POST /api/v1/ui/access answer.

results.description: Results answer Checks, in order. Without TokenReview every check is allowed (the UI API then acts as the controller for anyone who reaches it) except create approvals, which needs the caller's identity.

user.description: User is the verified caller; absent when the UI API does not identify callers (no TokenReview), so an action that names who decided (an approval) cannot be taken from the UI.

allowed.description: Allowed is whether the caller may do it.

grantedBy.description: GrantedBy names the chart's user roles that grant it ("approver or admin"), when the chart grants it to particular roles.

reason.description: Reason says why it is not allowed when that is not a missing role (an approval without TokenReview).

uiAccessUser.description: uiAccessUser is who the caller is, as TokenReview verified.

uiActorRef.description: uiActorRef is who shipped a version, in short, for the views that list many versions (the fleet board, the Agents filter, the station map): the Bundle's actor kind, its agent and sponsor, and the sentence the Bundle API's actorText gives.

kind.description: Kind is human, agent, bot or controller.

principal.description: Principal is the username the API server authenticated.

text.description: Text is the actor as one sentence ("agent fixer for alice").

uiApprovalRequest.description: uiApprovalRequest is the body of POST /api/v1/ui/approvals.

bundle.description: Bundle is the Bundle decided on.

comment.description: Comment is a note shown with the decision.

decision.description: Decision is "approve" or "reject". Ignored with revoke.

environment.description: Environment is the environment whose approval gates count the decision.

namespace.description: Namespace of the Bundle. Defaults to "default".

revoke.description: Revoke deletes the user's decision instead of recording one.

uiApprovalResponse.description: uiApprovalResponse is the response of POST /api/v1/ui/approvals.

approval.description: Approval is the name of the Approval recorded or deleted.

user.description: User is who the decision is recorded for: the authenticated UI user.

uiBundleRejection.description: uiBundleRejection is spec.rejected of a Bundle.

uiDeployed.description: uiDeployed is what one environment runs, for the fleet board.

actor.description: Actor is who shipped Bundle (docs/actors.md); absent when that is not known (a Bundle from before actor stamps, or one that is gone).

configFrom.description: ConfigFrom, under an image Bundle, is the last Bundle that deployed a config commit there, and ConfigVersion that commit ("config abc1234"). ImagesFrom, under a config Bundle, is the last Bundle that deployed images, and ImagesVersion their tags. Image and config Bundles do not supersede each other, so the environment runs both, as kardinal status reports.

verifiedAt.description: VerifiedAt is the RFC 3339 time its step in the environment was Verified (the latest region); empty while it is still health checking.

version.description: Version is scm.BundleVersion of that Bundle; empty when the Bundle is gone.

uiDisplayState.description: uiDisplayState is how one API state is shown (pkg/display): the same labels as the CLI.

ascii.description: ASCII is the glyph for a surface without Unicode.

glyph.description: Glyph is a one-character Unicode symbol for the state.

label.description: Label is the text a person reads, for example "Waiting for PR merge".

tone.description: Tone is the status bucket that picks colour and shape: verified, promoting, waiting, blocked, failed, superseded, paused, held, pending, degraded or unknown.

value.description: Value is the API value, unchanged, for example WaitingForMerge.

uiDisplayStates.description: uiDisplayStates is the response of GET /api/v1/ui/display-states: every known state of each kind, keyed by API value. A value not listed is shown with its CamelCase split into words and tone unknown.

gate.description: Gate maps the state of a gate instance (Pass, Block, Waiting, Pending, Superseded, Rejected).

held.description: Held is the label of an environment held by a rollback (rollback --hold).

heldByGate.description: HeldByGate is the label of an environment a gate holds; {gate} is the gate's name. Its tone is blocked.

pipeline.description: Pipeline maps Pipeline status.phase values, and Paused.

step.description: Step maps PromotionStep status.state values, and NotStarted (an environment not reached yet).

substep.description: SubStep maps the state of a PromotionStep's status.steps[].

uiFleet.description: uiFleet is a fleet environment's targets and pacing (spec.fleet).

maxConcurrent.description: MaxConcurrent is spec.fleet.maxConcurrent (0: every target at once).

maxUnavailable.description: MaxUnavailable is spec.fleet.maxUnavailable as a count of the targets (a percentage rounded up, at least 1): that many Failed targets stop the rollout. Absent when unset.

maxUnavailableSpec.description: MaxUnavailableSpec is spec.fleet.maxUnavailable as written ("10%", "2"). Absent when unset.

message.description: Message says why the targets cannot be resolved (a selector fleet).

paused.description: Paused: the fleet is in spec.pausedFleets (kardinal pause --env <fleet>), so no further target starts.

targets.description: Targets are the target environments ("<environment>-<target>"), in the order they are promoted.

uiFleetTargetRollback.description: uiFleetTargetRollback is one target of the rollback of a fleet.

changes.description: Changes is false when the target runs what the rollback restores already: its step is Verified at once.

runs.description: Runs is the Bundle whose change landed there last; absent when none.

uiGateApproval.description: uiGateApproval is a gate's approval policy (spec.approval) and how the gate counted the decisions it has (status.approvals).

approved.description: Approved is the number of counted approve decisions; Rejected is true when a counted reject blocks the gate.

decisions.description: Decisions are status.approvals, in the order the gate recorded them.

required.description: Required is how many distinct allowed people must approve (default 1).

uiGateDecision.description: uiGateDecision is one approve or reject decision as the gate counted it.

uiGateVerdict.description: uiGateVerdict is one Verdict as the gate counted it.

highFindings.description: HighFindings are the findings of high severity among Findings.

verifierActor.description: VerifierActor is who wrote the verdict, in short, for the UI's actor badge (from the gate's copy of the Verdict); absent when not known.

uiGateVerify.description: uiGateVerify is a verify gate's policy (spec.verify) and how the gate counted the verdicts it has (status.verdicts).

allowedAgents.description: AllowedAgents are the agents whose verdicts count.

check.description: Check is the verification the gate waits for; Environment the environment verified.

onInconclusive.description: OnInconclusive is hold, retry or fail; Timeout the wait ("" none).

passed.description: Passed and Failed count the gate's counted pass and fail votes.

required.description: Required is how many votes must pass; MaxFailures how many failing votes the gate tolerates.

uiHoldResponse.description: uiHoldResponse is a Pipeline environment hold (spec.holds).

bundle.description: Bundle is the rollback Bundle the environment is held on.

bundleMissing.description: BundleMissing is true when the controller found the rollback Bundle missing (status.holdStates). The hold stays in effect.

createdBy.description: CreatedBy is who held the environment.

expiresAt.description: ExpiresAt is when the controller removes the hold, RFC 3339; empty: when it is released.

message.description: Message says what is wrong and how to recover, with BundleMissing.

releaseCommand.description: ReleaseCommand is the CLI command that releases the hold.

uiReleaseHoldRequest.description: uiReleaseHoldRequest is the body of POST /api/v1/ui/release-hold.

namespace.description: Namespace of the Pipeline. Defaults to "default".

pipeline.description: Pipeline is the Pipeline whose environment is held.

uiToken.description: The static UI token (ui.auth.tokenSecretRef) or, with ui.auth.tokenReview, a Kubernetes token (kubectl create token) whose user Kubernetes RBAC authorizes for each request. With neither mode set, the UI API takes no credentials and answers only loopback peers (kubectl port-forward).

post.description: Answers only for the UI's actions (create bundles, create approvals, update policygates/override, pipelines/pause, pipelines/hold, bundles/reject), in a DNS-1123 namespace (the --watch-namespace one when set) with DNS-1123 names; at most 32 checks in 16 KiB, each distinct check reviewed once. In TokenReview mode each check is a SubjectAccessReview for the verified caller, cached for 30s and limited per user and in total, for this endpoint only (429 past either, saying which); a denial is an answer (allowed: false), not a 403. Without TokenReview every check is allowed and no user is named, except create approvals (an approval names who decided).
